description: DEPTH AS AN INFERRED DIMENSION -- monocular structure-from-motion, the DEPTH sibling of time_axis. A scene with real (discrete) depth translated past a moving eye produces a 2D image transformation that NO SINGLE flat generator can explain: near layers sweep faster than far ones (motion parallax). That unexplained residual -- DIFFERENT regions needing DIFFERENT translate generators -- IS the depth signal. The decision is the Rust DepthInfer Term (the residual-of-TimeInfer op): each observable SURFACE (cells sharing their non-coord slots) must be a rigid constant-velocity translate (the SAME rigidity test TimeInfer runs, per region); >=2 DISTINCT surface velocities mint latent:depth, the ordinal dimension indexing surfaces by motion (faster = nearer, n_layers = distinct-velocity count READ FROM THE DATA). <=1 distinct velocity -> ONE generator carries the scene -> residual ZERO -> NO depth (a flat scene, even a multi-colour one at a single velocity, mints NOTHING -- the decisive anti-forced control: depth minted from VELOCITY VARIATION, never from the mere presence of multiple regions). Integer/in-frame only; continuous perspective (a real velocity gradient) is CROSS-FRAME and DEFERRED, like real-angle rotation. Flag-gated on agent.depth_infer_enabled==1, absent by default (OFF, PROTOCOL section 9); the whole seed is inert without it AND matches only status=='depth_seq' observations, which the normal decode ladder never produces.

microtheory.name: depth_axis
microtheory.description: multi-velocity motion field -> per-surface translate generators + latent:depth ordering (+ downstream prediction of an unseen view); flat/single-velocity -> no depth. The residual of TimeInfer's single-generator question, read as discrete depth (monocular structure-from-motion).

rules.name: depth_infer_mint
rules.comment: MULTI-DEPTH motion field -> mint a latent:depth dimension. Flag ON (agent.depth_infer_enabled==1). On a depth-sequence Observation (status=='depth_seq') whose per-surface motions carry >=2 DISTINCT constant velocities (DepthInfer(frames).explained==1), mint LatentDimension{name:'latent:depth', ...} carrying n_layers (distinct-velocity count read from the data), the per-layer velocities and the surface ORDERING near->far, and record the DOWNSTREAM prediction obs.predicted = the UNSEEN view at tick K with each surface advanced by its OWN velocity (the view a single generator CANNOT produce -- PROTOCOL section 1 clause 5), and mark status='depth_inferred'. Idempotence guard: only if not already depth-inferred.

rules.name: depth_infer_floor
rules.comment: FLAT / single-velocity / shuffled / non-rigid scene -> grounds at enumeration, NO depth. Flag ON. On a depth-sequence Observation whose per-surface motion field does NOT carry >=2 distinct constant velocities (DepthInfer(frames).explained!=1), mint NO dimension -- mark status='depth_none'. This is the honest MDL floor ('no depth dimension shorter than a single generator', provisional): a flat scene (one velocity everywhere), a multi-colour scene at a SINGLE velocity, a shuffled sequence (per-surface velocity not constant), or a non-rigid region all reach it. It must hold at the LONGEST window (a forced minter would eventually hallucinate a depth layering -- the section 1.1 dead-arm disease in the depth domain, which is DISQUALIFYING here).
